text:
Lars: Hi team, Lars here — first day! Quick set of Qs about onboarding security: do I need to enroll my personal Mac immediately or can I wait for the company laptop? Also curious if the phishing sims will hit me in week 1.
Maya (People Ops): Welcome Lars :tada: If you need repo or internal doc access today, enroll now. If you want a company laptop, file the hardware request (https://forms.redwood.com/loaner-laptop) and note "new hire" — shipping in 2 biz days.
Jenna (Security): Hi @Lars — short answers: enroll if accessing internal tools. Phishing sims typically start after day 3; new hires can request a 7-day grace if needed. FileVault is required for macOS: check with `fdesetup status`.
Lars: Thanks — are we required to put company creds in 1Password only? I use a personal manager right now.
IT Desk: Company policy: store company secrets in the org vault. We'll help migrate entries.
Lars: One more — Im neurodivergent and timed modules are rough. Is there an accommodation route for the security training?
Maya (People Ops): Yes — we can extend the training window or provide alternate formats. DM me and we'll flag you for an accommodation.
security-bot: Automated notice: Phishing simulations come from simulation@redwood-security.test with "[Redwood Simulation]" in the subject. Report suspected sims to get a micro-training email.
Lars: Great, Ill enroll and DM Maya about the accommodation. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
